title: STAGE: Stateful Translation to Agentic Graph Execution with Policy-Scoped Context and Deterministic Control
abstract: arXiv:2608.22538v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Policy-governed agents must interpret case evidence while following an authorized procedure. We present \textsc{Stage}, an executable-graph framework that confines model judgment to policy-scoped nodes while placing procedural control in deterministic code. At each node, the model receives task-relevant policy context and returns a typed result, while the coordinator enforces the reviewed execution contract. We evaluate \textsc{Stage} on SOP-Bench Referral Abuse, two $\tau^2$-bench domains, and Smart Dispute, a proprietary banking benchmark. Compared with monolithic full-policy execution, \textsc{Stage} generally improves task success and repeated-run reliability across workflows of varying procedural complexity. The largest gains occur on the deeper Telecom and Smart Dispute workflows, where $\mathrm{Pass}^3$ increases by 7.5--55.0 and 57.2--65.7 percentage points, respectively, depending on the model. translated_title: STAGE：状态化翻译到智能体图执行，采用策略范围上下文与确定性控制
translated_abstract: 策略治理的智能体必须在遵循授权程序的同时解释案件证据。我们提出了\textsc{Stage}，一个可执行图框架，它将模型判断限制在策略范围的节点内，同时将程序控制置于确定性代码中。在每个节点上，模型接收任务相关的策略上下文并返回类型化结果，而协调器则强制执行审查过的执行契约。我们在SOP-Bench转介滥用、两个$\tau^2$-bench领域以及专有银行基准Smart Dispute上评估了\textsc{Stage}。与单片全策略执行相比，\textsc{Stage}在具有不同程序复杂性的工作流中普遍提高了任务成功率和重复运行可靠性。最大的提升出现在更深的电信和Smart Dispute工作流中，其中$\mathrm{Pass}^3$分别增加了7.5至55.0和57.2至65.7个百分点，具体取决于模型。这些结果表明，结合策略范围上下文与确定性控制能有效提升智能体执行性能。
tldr: 该论文提出STAGE框架，通过将模型判断限制在策略范围节点并利用确定性代码控制程序流程，显著提升了复杂工作流中的任务成功率和重复可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces STAGE, a framework that confines model judgment to policy-scoped nodes while using deterministic code for procedural control, significantly improving task success and repeated-run reliability in complex workflows.
